d: Shaded valley. On one side of the temple. A few sheds scattered, and the river Osso in the distance. Many Scythians, who come out of the julivian temple, then Indatiro, and Sozame taken by the hand, at Ermodano.
Ermodane, and Scythians.
Inside the hut of Sozame. It is formed of rushes, and wins vaguely connected. Obeida (she proves a deep sadness), then Zulma.
Inditrate, Sozame, Obeida, and Zulma.
Alone Zulma.

A steep mountain; it is half bound up with the woods. There are scattered huts. Atamaro is seen descending from the top of the mountain with Ircano and his followers. Some of his followers remain on it: then Inditario with Scythians.
Zulma, Ircano.
Great temple of the Scythians. Ara lit in the middle. Scythians, and Scythians. A great priest with a wedding ring, many other priests around the altar.
Inditrate, Ermodano, Atamaro, Sozame, Ircano, after a short break.
View of the huts of the Scythians. Atamaro, and Ircano, and Persians.
Sozame with Scythians, and sayings.
Obeida, and Zulma; then Atamaro, then Inditar, and Sozame, and sayings.
Shady valley, Scythian choir, and Ermodan.
Indi Atamaro with Ircano.
Inside the hut of Sozame. Obeida. She is immersed in deep thought. Sozame: he enters, sees it, observes it, then approaching them in a severe tone.
Obeida, and Zulma.
Great temple. Great Scythian priest, Priests, Scythians, Scythians, Scythian women, Sozam, Hermodan; we sing the following:
Outdoors of the hut of Sozame: many others, nearby woods. Atamaro, Ircano, and Scythians.
With Obeida, and few Scythians, and sayings; then Hircan.
Sozame, and Ermodano with Scythians, and sayings, then Atamaro.
Inditrate, Sozame, Ermodano, and Scici victoriosi.
Very large caves: in the bottom there is a hole in one side, so you go to the river. Obeida, which leads Atamaro.
Sozame, Indator, and sayings, and Scythians.
Zulma, then Ermodano.
Obeida, then Sozame, then Scythian chorus.
Ermodano, and Scici; then Zulma.

Sacred wood destined for sacrifices. Simulation of vengeance in the middle. Ara in the middle, and knife consecrated on it. Great priest, Priests, and People, Ermodano is on the left of the ara, the Great priest on the right. Sozame on one side.
Obeida, Sozame, Ermodano, Zulma, Scici, then Atamaro. Obeida will remain focused and thoughtful.
Hindu, and sayings.
